clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, orc warlock Kaal Soulreaper trains apprentices and keeps close ties with practitioners of the dark arts across the Horde. Among the Forsaken, he guides students toward mentors in distant lands.

Kaal Soulreaper works in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, where Horde warlocks come to learn from his mastery of demonic entities and curses. Thrall's Horde strictly regulates and monitors fel magic within Orgrimmar, while the subterranean sanctums of Lordaeron offer practitioners like Kaal ample harbor. Beyond teaching, Kaal connects those seeking greater power with mentors across the sea, including Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
